For fixed apex, a single-site move cannot change winding. For an apex change, both exhaustive independent verifiers inspect every possible legal move and confirm the signed adjustment. Recursive proper-colouring search and independent 240-C5-word/shadow-product enumeration both give 12480 states. One forms edges from local neighbour constraints and the other from Hamming-one coordinate buckets; both give 45240 edges, two invariant connected classes of size 6240, a full degree polynomial, and 56 symmetry orbit representatives with exact eccentricities. A concrete 3-degeneracy order plus known degeneracy-plus-two theorem proves 5-colour connectedness. Finite exhaustiveness supports this finite statement only; scripts replay from embedded files.

value.rationale: This is the smallest triangle-free four-chromatic graph. Four named colours are its natural optimum palette, so the reachability of the complete proper-colouring space under single-site updates is a motivated exact invariant for combinatorial reconfiguration and Glauber-type sampling. All optimum configurations have at least five legal recolourings, yet the chain is reducible into exactly two nontrivial winding sectors. Sharp connectivity transition at five colours, exact sector metric and an explicit invariant make this a complete finite structural classification, not an arbitrary enumeration or known-table recomputation.
